display.purpose: The verdict figure in brass, the one figure each tool exists to produce. 32px under 860px.

headline.purpose: The tool name as the page h1. 24px under 860px.

title.purpose: Settings group titles and report sheet titles.

body.purpose: Running text; intros capped at 72ch, help notes at 68ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked heading for the index groups and server-settings groups only.

figure.purpose: Mono tabular face for coordinates, counts, ticks, table cells and stamps.

shadows.name: sheet-on-desk
shadows.purpose: The report sheet resting on the desk. The only surface shadow.

motion.name: reink
motion.purpose: A 2px brass stroke sweeps under a changed verdict figure once. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border transitions on controls and index links.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#ece8dd);border-radius:3px;background:var(--ink,#ece8dd);color:var(--ground,#111418);font-family:var(--font, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s ease}.ds-btn:hover{background:#fffaf0}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal,#e0a43c);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Dashed add action, e.g. add an attacker.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{min-height:40px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px dashed var(--rule-strong,#404956);border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-2,#b9bcc2);font-family:var(--font, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s ease,color .15s ease}.ds-btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--ink-3,#8f96a0);color:var(--ink,#ece8dd)}.ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal,#e0a43c);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Small bordered secondary action, e.g. copy.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-quiet"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2"/><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"/></svg>Copier</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:32px;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#404956);border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-2,#b9bcc2);font-family:var(--font, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s ease,border-color .15s ease,color .15s ease}.ds-btn-quiet:hover{border-color:var(--ink-3,#8f96a0);background:var(--sheet-2,#1f242c);color:var(--ink,#ece8dd)}.ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal,#e0a43c);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Chips
components.description: Segmented choices; selection is ink, never brass.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.ds-chip{min-height:36px;padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#404956);border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-2,#b9bcc2);font-family:var(--font-figure, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, monospace);font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s ease,background-color .15s ease,color .15s ease}.ds-chip:hover{border-color:var(--ink-3,#8f96a0);color:var(--ink,#ece8dd)}.ds-chip.is-active{border-color:var(--ink,#ece8dd);background:var(--sheet-3,#262c35);color:var(--ink,#ece8dd);font-weight:700}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal,#e0a43c);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Field
components.description: One-line labelled input, label left, value right.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:0 14px;min-height:52px;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#404956);border-radius:3px;background:var(--sheet-2,#1f242c);font-family:var(--font, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif);transition:border-color .15s ease}.ds-field:focus-within{border-color:var(--signal,#e0a43c)}.ds-field-label{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink-2,#b9bcc2)}.ds-field input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:none;background:transparent;padding:12px 0;text-align:right;font:700 22px var(--font, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink,#ece8dd)}

narrative.overview:
Every tool hands down its verdict as a report: a dated, ruled document on a graphite telex desk at night. The lineage is the combat and espionage reports OGame players have pasted into forums and Discord since 2002. The verdict is the first thing read and the thing copied back into chat, so the whole system is arranged to make one figure unmistakable and everything around it quiet.

The world is flat paper on a dark desk. A sticky index rail holds the brand, the one universe picker and the tool list; the desk to its right shows one tool at a time, its settings column beside the report sheet. Surfaces are told apart by small steps of graphite and by 1px rules, never by colour or glow. Numbers that are read, compared or copied are set in a tabular face. One brass ink is the only accent, and its rarity is what makes the verdict land.

The build refuses the neon HUD card stack of the previous UI and the generic SaaS dashboard: no glow, no glass, no decorative gradient, no pills.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, three sheet steps, warm paper ink.
One brass signal ink, reserved for a short list of meanings.
1px rules everywhere; ruled lists and tables instead of cards in cards.
Tabular numerals, with a mono face for coordinates, counts, ticks and stamps.
Corners of 3px at most; status marks are rectangular stamps.
A single motion signature: a changed figure is re-inked by one brass stroke.

rules.name: The Brass Reservation Rule
rules.body: Brass means "this is the answer, this has focus, or this is where you are." It marks the verdict figures, focus, the open tool, the selected heatmap cell and the curve's current point. Any other use dilutes the verdict.

rules.name: The Ink Selection Rule
rules.body: Selection that is not the open tool is shown with ink: an ink border or ink outline and a step-up sheet fill (chips, list rows, language toggle). The selected resource tile is the one exception, and it uses that resource's own data ink.

rules.name: The Data Ink Rule
rules.body: Metal, crystal and deuterium colours only ever describe a resource. They never colour a button, a heading or a frame.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Any number a player compares or copies is tabular; numbers in rows, tables, ticks and stamps use the mono face.

rules.name: The One Loud Figure Rule
rules.body: Only the verdict reaches display size. Nothing else on a report competes with it.

rules.name: The Paper Not Light Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by tone and 1px rules. No glow, no glass, no blur, and no gradient except the slider track fill that shows the value.

dos: Do keep brass to the verdict figures, focus, the open tool, the selected heatmap cell and the curve's current point.
Do show any other selection with an ink border or outline and a step-up sheet fill (sheet-2 for hover, sheet-3 for selected).
Do separate surfaces with 1px rules and graphite steps; rule lists and tables instead of nesting cards.
Do set compared or copied numbers tabular, and in the mono face when they sit in rows, tables, ticks or stamps.
Do make status marks rectangular stamps with 2px corners and a 1px border.
Do colour the galaxy heatmap with the single graphite-to-ink ramp (heat-0 to heat-4, then ink).
Do keep metal, crystal and deuterium inks on resource data only.
Do keep the report beside the settings and sticky on wide screens so the verdict is read without scrolling.
donts: Don't use glows, glass, blur or decorative gradients; the slider's value fill is the only gradient.
Don't add coloured side stripes to cards, notes or rows.
Don't round anything past 3px, and don't make status marks into pills.
Don't add a second accent colour, or use brass for decoration, hover flourishes or headings.
Don't set any figure other than the verdict at display size.
Don't add shadows beyond the report sheet's single drop shadow and the slider thumb's contact shadow.
